summary: 15-year-old backpacker slid ~200 ft down a steep snowfield in the Outward Bound Couloir near Challenger Point/Kit Carson Peak after entering a winter-mountaineering route via Google Maps navigation; Saguache SAR was committed elsewhere so AVSAR took incident command; CO Army National Guard 'Guardian 1' flew rescuers into Willow Lake Basin; technical lowering ~200 ft; deep lacerations to hands and legs, stable; airlifted to incident command then transported to San Luis Valley Regional Medical Center.
location: Outward Bound Couloir, near Challenger Point / Kit Carson Peak
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer Search and Rescue; Saguache Search and Rescue; Colorado Army National Guard
